summary: Tested the new Team Activity feature (backend GET /api/orgs/{org_id}/team-activity + frontend /team page) plus regression of previously fixed flows. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass, including 5 new Team Activity tests (200 for owner, full response-shape validation, active_timer populated after timer/start with live elapsed_seconds and correct sorting, 403 for 'member' role, 401 unauthenticated, 403 non-member org). Frontend: admin sees 'Team Activity' nav (nav-team), page renders 3 KPI cards (1 active timer / 1 in-progress / 6m logged today), 2 member rows with avatar+name+role badge, orange active-timer panel that ticks live (01:35 -> 01:37), 'No active timer' fallback for the other member, active/today/week stats, in-progress list with priority badges, 40h capacity bar with %, recent time entries. refresh-activity-btn works; 15s auto-refresh interval + 1s tick interval verified in code. Member-role user: nav-team hidden and direct /team shows 'Access restricted' card. Regression all pass: login, all 5 task views (list/board/gantt/calendar/workload), kanban drag (todo -> in_progress persisted), timer start/stop from list view, workspace-create dialog no longer blocks sidebar clicks. No 5xx, no console errors on the happy path.

minor.issue: Unbounded in-memory aggregation: loads all tasks (to_list(5000)), memberships (500) and week time entries (2000) then does O(members x tasks) Python filtering. Will degrade for large orgs; consider aggregation pipeline / indexes on (org_id, assignee_id) and (org_id, date).
updates filter drops all None values, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. remove assignee/due_date). Verified estimate_hours:null is silently ignored -> no 500 risk, but clearing is impossible.

integration_issues.issue: After a 403 the 15s polling interval keeps firing, producing repeated 403 network/console errors indefinitely on the restricted screen. Clear the interval (or stop polling) when err is set.

issues: Layout, contrast and spacing look good; no issues found. Minor: member email is truncated to ~15 chars in the identity block (test_qa_member_178...) with no title/tooltip.

action_items: Optional: stop the 15s auto-refresh interval on the Team Activity page once a 403/error state is reached (currently spams 403s).
Optional: add title attribute/tooltip for truncated member email on activity rows.
Optional: split /app/backend/server.py (750 lines) into routers (auth, orgs, tasks, time, activity, analytics).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds the 700-line guideline (750) — split into routers/modules.
team_activity correctly excludes _id and password_hash and handles naive datetimes for started_at; no ObjectId leakage found.

Frontend TeamActivity uses m.estimate_hours.toFixed(1) — safe today because backend always sends a number (PATCH drops nulls), but a defensive Number(m.estimate_hours || 0) would harden it against legacy docs.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the new feature. The only behavioural nit is TeamActivity.jsx setting up setInterval(load, 15000) unconditionally in an effect that is not cancelled when load() results in a 403, so restricted users generate a 403 request every 15s.
